voxy.config.title: Voxy
voxy.config.general.serviceThreads.toolt: Number of threads the ServiceThreadPool can use
voxy.config.general.useSodiumBuilder.too: Uses sodium builder threads as part of voxys thread pool, can reduce stuttering and lag when moving quickly at high render distance
voxy.config.general.ingest.tooltip: Enables or disables voxies ability to convert new chunks into LoDs
voxy.config.general.subDivisionSize.tool: Maximum size in pixels (squared) of screenspace AABB before subdiving to smaller LoDs (Smaller being higher quality)
voxy.config.general.renderDistance.toolt: Render distance of voxy in chunks
voxy.config.general.environmental_fog.to: Enables or disables voxy rendering environmental fog
voxy.config.general.render_fog.tooltip: Enables or disables render fog effect
voxy.config.general.ssao_mode.tooltip: The mode used for screen-space ambient occlusion (Auto balances quality and performance)
voxy.config.general.skyFogDistance.toolt: Fog distance in chunks for the sky and Voxy terrain
voxy.config.general.fogIntensity.tooltip: Opacity of optional Voxy distance fog; medium fog such as underwater remains active
voxy.config.general.fogDensity.tooltip: Moves optional fog toward the far end; zero uses a linear curve
voxy.config.general.adaptCloudDistance.t: Extends cloud distance with the current render distance
voxy.config.general.renderPressure.toolt: Controls the per-frame LOD construction budget
voxy.config.general.leafLodMode.tooltip: Fast uses opaque leaves; Balanced and Quality preserve cutout transparency
voxy.config.general.earthCurveRatio.tool: 0 disables curvature; larger values produce a stronger curve beyond the vanilla chunk boundary.
voxy.config.general.showJoinMessage.tool: Show a version message whenever joining a server or world; disable it here.
voxy.config.general.fogDistancePercent.t: Scales optional distance fog against the LOD render radius.
voxy.config.general.biomeBlendRadius.too: Smooths LOD water colours across biome borders; changing it rebuilds the renderer.
voxy.config.fakesight.enabled.tooltip: Requests extra chunks in singleplayer. Expansion pauses while moving and resumes gradually while stationary.
voxy.config.fakesight.distance.tooltip: Singleplayer request radius, capped at 48 chunks to limit CPU and memory pressure.
voxy.join.disableHint: This join message can be disabled from Neo Voxy in Embeddium Video Settings.
voxy.join.upgradeCleanup: If an update causes problems, delete the Neo Voxy config and the world's Voxy cache before retrying.
